PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Accepts absolute POSIX, drive-letter, UNC, and translated Windows device paths such as /repo, D:\work, D:/work, or //?/D:/work. Empty or non-directory values are treated as absent; when absent, every file path must already be absolute.

file.description: Use the exact file path to create. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. When PWD resolves to an existing directory, relative file values are resolved from that root; otherwise file must already be absolute.

content.description: Use the complete content for the brand-new file. Empty content is allowed and creates an empty file.

files.description: Use for batch file creation. Provide up to 10 items, each with file and content. Do not send this field together with root-level file/content.

file.description: Use the exact file path to create for this batch item. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. Relative paths require a valid root-level PWD.

content.description: Use the complete content for this brand-new file. Empty content is allowed and creates an empty file.

apply.description: Leave false for preview. Set true only when the previewed file creation is ready to write. In batch mode this apply flag is shared by all files.
